headline: SKM Egg Products submits annual general meeting minutes to exchange
hook: AGM minutes filed for SKM Egg
summary: SKM Egg Products Export (India) Limited has officially submitted the minutes of its Annual General Meeting held on September 18, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing is a standard corporate compliance procedure to record shareholder proceedings. Retail investors should note this is routine reporting without new financial impact or operational guidance. No immediate price action is expected from this procedural disclosure.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on stock price.
